physical.fixing: tool-less, pegs into square rail holes, magnetic

base.description: One FHU-BPA-1U-10 panel as FS ships it, one of the ten in the pack.

description: 1U 19in tool-less ABS blanking panel, FS FHU-BPA-1U-10: one black moulded plate 44 x 482 mm with a raised panel across its face and a channel 22 mm deep behind it, held to the rails by pegs and magnets at each end (FS's "self-attaching, magnetic design"). Sold ten to a pack.

gaps.note: the product page calls the part "Magnetic Design" and the datasheet tool-less; the renders show both pegs and a metal disc at each end. Which of the two holds it in a round-hole rail is not said.
gaps.wanted: a rear photograph or the QSG text

name: fhu-bpa-1u-10

chassis.note: the plate is the part: "1.73 x 19.00 in (44 x 482 mm)", one moulded ABS plate the width of the rack, its ends carrying the pegs and magnets that hold it, so the face is drawn at 482 (the owner's rule of 2026-10-09; lint L43 stands down for a body this wide).

color.note: black textured ABS ("Fine Texture Design"), slightly lighter on the moulded panel in the render.

depth.note: 22: FS's dimensioned render (x8) prints 22 mm for the moulding's depth and 482 and 44 for its length and height. The 3D body is that box across the full width; the real ends are only the plate.

eia.note: EIA-310 hole positions: the rail holes of each rack unit stand 6.35, 22.225 and 38.1 mm up from its bottom, and the two rails' holes are 465.1 mm apart across the rack. The plate is taken as centred in the rack units it fills, so a hole's height on the plate is its height in the units less half the difference between the units and the plate.

face.note: the moulded panel on the face - wide at the ends, narrowing over the middle third - is the stencil's outline (16.0 to 466.3 across; 8.4 to 37.7 high at the ends, 14.2 to 32.3 over the middle), drawn as three fields without the slanted transitions; the render (g3) shows the same shape in relief.

fixing.note: the quick start guide draws two pegs at each end of the back entering the rail's square holes from the front, on the unit's top and bottom holes (EIA-310); the close-up (x9) shows a round metal disc at each end, which is the "Magnetic Design" of the product page title. The datasheet calls the part tool-less and says nothing of magnets. The pegs are drawn 5 mm and the magnets 10 mm across, both estimated, the magnets centred on the end of the plate's back.

lifecycle.note: checked 2026-10-09 against what the intake holds: the FS product page for this SKU was live when the intake read it on 2026-10-08, and the FS documentation portal's Accessories tree, read the same day, carries no end-of-sale notice for it. No web search beyond FS's own pages was made.

mark.note: FS's mark is moulded into the left of the panel; it is a logo and is not drawn.

method.note: the FS Blanking Panel Datasheet (portal 2125), FHU-BPA-1U-10 column, and the product page for the size, material and weight; the face from the FS Blanking Panel Visio stencil, master FHU-BPA-1U-10, checked against the straight-on gallery render of SKU 133347 (g3); the depth and the back from the dimensioned render (x8), the close-up (x9) and the quick start guide (QSG V1.0, portal 422).

sides.note: the plate's end edge-on, the moulding's walls and the open channel between them, as the render x8 shows the end.

walls.note: the moulding's top and bottom walls run 20.9 to 461.1: the straight-on render (g3) at 2.97 px/mm puts their ends 20.9 in from each end of the plate. Their 2 mm thickness, and the plate's, are estimated.

weight.note: the datasheet and product page: 1.108 kg for the pack of ten, so 0.111 a panel (derived).
